variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, medium height, long slender variety suitable for transplanting under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BINA and released in 2007 for planting in Aman season. Also recommended for planting in Boro and Aus season due to its short duration. Lodging tolerant. Good taste. Tolerant to sheath blight, leaf blight, BPH.
